## Friction To Remove

What becomes difficult, repetitive, expensive, or unreliable today?

## Desired Outcome

## Intelligence-Layer Fit

Which capability does this strengthen: durable continuity, explainable
retrieval, portable context, verified learning, privacy, or agent adoption?

## Interface And Lane

- Why should this live in the CLI, a companion surface, or internal tooling?
- Should it be public, commercial, or private development?

## Proof

How would a deterministic test or evaluation show the feature improved real
agent work without weakening privacy, provenance, or release boundaries?
